reading.zh: 无状态传输在最左；调度器给并发与速率卡口；resolve 负责失败分类与兜底；cache 是入口策略（TTL/合并/冷却）并最终发起 resolve。
reading.en: Stateless transport on the far left; the scheduler caps concurrency and rate; resolve classifies failures and falls back; cache is the entry policy (TTL, coalescing, cooldown) that ultimately triggers a resolve.
